bear_case: Monday's +0.30% SPX gain obscures a regime that has not improved and has worsened in one dimension: DXY broke above 100 (new trigger breach), Iran's ceasefire is 'no longer feasible,' Brent rose to $96.05 within $1 of the $97 trigger, the 30Y is 0.1bps from 5.0%, and CPI Wednesday carries ~67% probability of a hot print. The MU/INTC dead-cat bounces (+~10% each) that drove the session's headline gain are a distribution opportunity for desks reducing gross ahead of the week's triple catalyst sequence (CPI, SPCX pricing, PPI) — not a regime repair. The AAPL WWDC sell-the-news (-1.89% after a $317 intraday spike) is the session's tell: narrative is not enough. If May CPI prints ≥4.2% YoY on Wednesday, the 30Y breaks cleanly through 5.0%, the Warsh FOMC June 17 becomes a live hike discussion, and SPX 7,250 is the next meaningful support. Invalidation: if CPI prints ≤3.8% YoY with core ≤0.2% m/m AND SPX closes above 7,460 on CPI day, the call reverts to HOLD.
